# Just 4 kiDDS Dentistry for Children

> A pediatric dental practice with locations in Idaho Falls and Pocatello specializing in kid-friendly dental care, preventive services, and emergency treatment.

Just 4 kiDDS Dentistry for Children operates two locations in Idaho (Idaho Falls and Pocatello) with a team of pediatric dentists dedicated to making dental visits enjoyable for children. The practice offers comprehensive services including cleanings, exams, fillings, crowns, and sedation options, accepting most major insurance plans including Medicaid.
